summary: Restyle readback verifies presence, uniqueness and within-block run order; it does not require authored block order to equal source shape order.
invariants: Every source text block is bound to exactly one visible DOM owner, and no block is bound twice.
The runs projected from one source block appear in source order.
N source blocks sharing the same text still require N rendered occurrences.
Outline reading order and source unit identity are still compared with the manifest and fail closed.
The server-generated placement plan keeps its sealed source order in the allocator and the coverage gate.
forbidden: Fail a deck because one source block renders before or after another source block.
Report a missing-text failure as a reading-order failure.
rationale: Source shape order is PPTX XML order, not the source's own reading order: a top-right page number regularly precedes a bottom running footer.
Restyling assigns each source block a slot in the new template, so page numbers and running headers move into the template's own bands.
Measured on the stored 35-slide deck of job 1b59b81a: cross-block order rejected 30 of 35 slides; without it 27 pass and the remaining 8 fail on genuinely absent source text.
